blocks.text: The applications in a collection provide an overview of the configured applications. The Zscaler service provides predefined applications, or you can configure a customized application. Each application is designed to have corresponding probes associated with it.
Applications provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Configure or add applications by creating Web probes and Cloud Path probes for insight.
Configure tenant access for applications.
Manage the top private applications from Private Access based on port usage.

blocks.text: You can configure the following applications in the Zscaler Admin Console:

blocks.item: Custom Application: Customizable SaaS or web applications that you can create and onboard in the Zscaler Admin Console for your organization.
Network Application: Network applications where you can monitor their Cloud Path.

blocks.text: If you create a custom application, you must create a Web probe to enable it. Most applications have at least one Web probe and one Cloud Path probe to monitor the application's URL. Network applications are the exception, since they require only a single Cloud Path probe for monitoring. To learn more, see Monitoring the Applications Overview.
Alternatively, you can configure probes for unified communication applications or predefined applications.

Predefined applications are SaaS applications provided by the Zscaler Admin Console for you to configure for your organization. There are predefined paths for each application. Zscaler recommends that you configure these paths to a SaaS tenant for your organization for applications that require a tenant ID. By default, all predefined applications have preconfigured Web and Cloud Path probes and are automatically enabled when onboarded. To view the list of predefined applications, see Predefined Applications for ZDX.
For unified communication applications, you must onboard a tenant for them in order to configure probes for the application. To onboard a tenant, see:

blocks.item: Configuring Microsoft Teams Call Quality for ZDX
Configuring Webex Call Quality for ZDX
Configuring Zoom Call Quality for ZDX

blocks.text: For Microsoft Teams, in addition to the application's URL for monitoring the Teams client connectivity and call signaling (teams.microsoft.com), an additional Cloud Path is created to monitor the Teams Transport Relay service for handling media communication (world.tr.teams.microsoft.com).
All probes that have been configured for the application are displayed, along with their current Status. To learn more, see Understanding Probes.
The Status for applications that are not yet fully activated appears as Pending Onboard.
On the Applications page (Digital Experience > Settings & Configurations > Probes > Select a collection to view applications), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Switch between the views. The default view is End User.
End User: View all the collections of configured applications and their configured probes. The total number of probes are displayed.
Managed: View all collections of applications with configured applications and their configured Zscaler Managed probes. The total number of probes are displayed.
Top Private Apps: Search and configure for top private applications based ports and protocol.
Depending on your ZDX role and subscription level, you might not see some of the views.

View collection metrics with the following information and actions:
Edit: Edit the collection name.
If the collection is a default collection (i.e., Unified Communication Collection, Predefined Apps Collection, Custom Apps Collection), then you cannot edit the collection name.
Status: The status of the collection.
Total Configured: The total number of enabled and disabled probes.
Probes: The number of Web probes and Cloud Path probes

Application Name: The name of the application.
